Row.Text: These others claim to be kings. Who among them can claim my godlike frame, my lapis beard, my flashing eyes?
I am Gilgamesh, slayer of the cedar monster, destroyer of heaven's bull, grower of luxuriant beards, and best of friends.

I am Gilgamesh, slayer of the cedar monster, destroyer of heaven's bull, grower of luxuriant beards, and best of friends.
Come, Enkidu! A new conquest awaits!
Death comes to the house where my bed is - so death shall follow where my feet go.
Shall I, too, pass and become clay? To lie down, and never rise again?
We shall clasp hands, and it will be done.
You squawk like the Anzu-bird, you crawl like the Lilītu.
What joy can there be in victory, when mortality still stalks my night-hours.
